geometry.note: D-036/D-053 (notebook build e9b41b8eaf) and D-055 adopt the modeled wall geometry. Native saved-solid measurements of the D-055 model verify 235 in cap/backwall, 251 in overall width, the two planar 2% backwall tops 4.25 in below the deck-top line (crown 4.0691 ft, edges 3.8733 ft above the cap top), the backwall volume and the lugged cheek volumes. This confirms calculation geometry only; COH-023 connection/detail review remains open.

wind_kz.note: Current JOURNAL C001WindLoadOnPedBridgeSuperstructure uses Category C and a common crown exposure height of 35 ft 8 23/64 in. K_Z_gov displays 1.019; 1.020 is a conservative upward rounding. Ground clearance remains a journal assumption; this confirms consistency with that basis.

landing.note: D-017 confirms 4 in slab bearing and 50% gravity share. D-053 verifies slab volumes A 111.987035 and B 89.038401 ft3 (the landings thicken locally to the lowered backwall tops; walking faces preserved). Use maximum volume / (4/12 ft) / (235/12 ft) as equivalent tributary length. Irregular plan extent is not a rectangular span; no stabilizing slab credit.

settlement.note: D-014 retains the required geotechnical confirmation of no more than 2 in settlement above cap bottom; no confirming report was found.

strap_level.note: D-019 sets a trial elevation of 1.5 ft above cap; no vendor reinforcement-level acceptance was found. Current journal MSEWallExclusion explicitly excludes elevation routing, side reinforcement and connection/development.

exposure.note: Materials module confirms concrete classes, but does not establish the environmental aggressivity classification for these covers. Existing code/exposure review remains open.

shrinkage.note: BridgeMovement explicitly covers thermal movement only. MCAD-S1/2 companion data are missing; no verified post-seating shrinkage strain was found. The 7.3e-5 template input remains provisional.

analysis.note: D-049/D-051: the registered End Bent 1 export (c1a4afa1...) is the analysis the selected cap case records, and the End Bent 2 export (3543df29...) reads the same bearing actions (DC 92.07, PL 28.98 kip per bearing; WS1/WS2/WS3 unchanged); both carry a 3 kip DC load at pile-head node 4. The bearing actions used here are therefore current to the 19 October exports. The prerequisite stays pending until the user confirms the common end-bent envelope and the FBMP model currency (COH-013/COH-028); not closed by this update.

cheek_connection.note: D-036/D-053/D-055 adopt geometry, not anchorage/load-path acceptance. The CAD cheek mats follow the 10 in spacing (D-039) with standard hooks where cover allows (D-046); development, lug WWR, cap interaction and strap interfaces remain COH-023; numerical interface capacity assumes developed bars.
